cases.reviewerAnswer: a (sabe) specifically expresses the missing learned skill; b (puede) can also express the child's inability to read.
cases.element: task.options[1]: label "puede", outcome "incorrect"; feedbackUk "Читати вчаться: це вміння, тому saber."
cases.defect: Poder can express general capacity, including an inability resulting from not having learned something. The stated situation therefore permits "no puede leer" as a broader description of the same inability. The prompt asks which verb fits, without requiring the verb that specifically denotes learned know-how.
cases.correction: Explicitly ask for the verb meaning 'know how to', or accept both options and explain that saber specifically identifies the missing learned skill.
sources: Course contract rule 2 and the review duty concerning acceptable answers rejected.
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, entries «poder» and «saber», meanings concerning capacity and learned ability (from memory).
